headlines.title: Democrats take House and Senate in historic midterm win
headlines.description: NBC News projects Democrats have won control of the House and Senate in the midterms. NBC News’ Ryan Nobles looks at some of the historic wins in states like Texas and Michigan along with Republican reaction.

headlines.title: Trump brags about the White House ballroom in his first post-election appearance
headlines.description: One day after elections in which Democrats took back the House and the Senate, the president addressed workers building the White House ballroom and said he didn’t regret starting the Iran war.

headlines.title: House Speaker Mike Johnson won’t stay on as Republican leader after GOP losses
headlines.description: House Majority Leader Steve Scalise, R-La., and Rep. Jim Jordan, R-Ohio, have already jumped in to run for Johnson’s place.

headlines.title: 5 key insights from the NBC News Exit Poll about the blue tsunami
headlines.description: Voters expressed feeling fed up with the economy; Democratic candidates emerged more well-liked, and Trump was resoundingly rejected.
headlines.source: Patrick J. Egan, NBC News Exit Poll Desk

headlines.title: Democrats gain full control of five state governments, further expanding the party’s power
headlines.description: Democrats gained total control of at least five state governments on Tuesday, giving the party a level of power it hasn’t held in some of those places in years.

headlines.title: Democrats score key secretary of state wins ahead of the 2028 election
headlines.description: Democrats won secretary of state contests in four presidential battlegrounds while making inroads in red territory, giving them election oversight authority in key states for the 2028 elections.

headlines.title: Tuesday’s elections bring historic first for Black governors
headlines.description: Wins by Byron Donalds in Florida, Keisha Lance Bottoms in Georgia and Wes Moore in Maryland mean multiple Black governors will serve simultaneously for the first time.

headlines.title: Troy Jackson defeats GOP Sen. Susan Collins in Maine, padding Democrats’ majority
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Jackson, who became the Democratic nominee after an embattled Graham Platner dropped out, flipped control of the Senate seat.

headlines.title: Record number of female governors elected
headlines.description: Voters in 15 states have elected female governors, setting a record as Democrats made sweeping gains in races up and down the ballot.

headlines.title: Tech moguls suffer defeat as midterm results show young men swinging away from Trump
headlines.description: Young men, a key voting block that helped President Trump return to the White House in 2024, are now swinging away from him even after tech billionaires spent a record amount on midterms. The results show critical cracks in the so-called "manosphere." NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: Former ‘Diddy’ prosecutor to lead investigation into alleged Cornell sexual assault
headlines.description: Former federal prosecutor Jacqueline Kelly, a Cornell graduate, was also the first head of the criminal civil rights division in the U.S. attorney’s office in Manhattan.

headlines.title: Stock market surges on election results
headlines.description: Investors drove the DOW up more than three percent with bullish sentiment following Democrats’ historic win in the elections. NBC News’ Christine Romans explains what helped push markets higher.
